[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,000 (Hard) |scale_hp = {{InfoboxContainer|Duo| *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]530 (Easy) *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,060 (Hard)}} {{InfoboxContainer|Trio| *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]560 (Easy) *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,110 (Hard)}} |defense = {{Defense}}30% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |cash = {{Money|1,000}} on death |hidden = No |fly = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''UFO''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Pls Donate]] as part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. It had a decent amount of health decent speed and defense. It was a [[Flying]] enemy, which made it unable to be targeted by towers without flying detection while also granting it multiple immunities ==Appearance== The '''UFO''' was a large flying vehicle that resembles a flying saucer. It was mostly blue with some blue neon parts on the sides. A giant neon blue orb was in the middle of it. ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS and flying detection, such as the [[Militant]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Mercenary Base]] are recommended against it. **Do note that for the [[Mercenary Base]], only the [[Rifleman]] can directly target the '''UFO'''. **More expensive options like the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ranger]] also work well, although beware of the [[Pursuit]]'s targeting and the [[Ranger]]'s slow firerate. *As the '''UFO''' is a [[Flying]] enemy, most units like the ones from the [[Military Base]] cannot collide or detect it. **However some units like [[Pistol Goon]] and [[Missile APC]] can detect and attack it. **The [[Military Base]] can still be used to kill the '''UFO''' with its ''Airstrike'' ability. *The [[Electroshocker]] can be quite useful to drop its defense and slow it down, since they move fast in groups and the [[Electroshocker]] is able to hit multiple '''UFOs'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} UFOFloat.gif|Floating animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''UFO''' on a promotional video. }} ==Trivia== *The '''UFO''' is a reference to the Alien Invasion Live Event in ''Pls Donate''. ==Update History== *'''13 November 2024''' - [[v1.41.0]] **'''UFO''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''UFO's''' defense. *'''4 December 2024''' - [[v1.44.0]] **'''UFO''' Removed. {{PlsDonate|[[Dev]] & [[Alien (Pls Donate)|Alien]]|Wave 15 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Dev]], [[Alien (Pls Donate)|Alien]] & [[Breaker4]]|hardw1 = Wave 15 (Hard)|UFO|Wave 16|[[Breaker4]]|Wave 18 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Corrupted Haz3mn]]|hardw3 = Wave 20 (Hard)}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:UFO}}
